notes: Plainer wording across the app, with technical terms swapped for everyday words.
After On My Way, directions open on their own (Apple Maps on iPhone). Turn it off on Profile under Open Directions After On My Way.
One address per place: the same address with different capitals, spacing or Dr vs Drive shows Already Saved, and Merge Duplicate Address fixes old copies in one tap.
Winterization shows how many are Left to Go this season, and Season and This Week count each address once.
A second blowout at the same address this season asks Mark Another? first (Cancel is the default) and still counts the address once.
Entering an address that another customer already has shows who has it, with Open That Customer or Save Anyway.
